findings.recommendation: The scenario 'Verify pass emit recommends review-as-system canonically' illustrates the graph's lead with '"/orbit:review --as system --fresh foo"' under spec-driven v4, whose first uncovered system slot was blind-pair. spec-driven is version 5: with nothing standing, its invoked slot presents the pair command (`/orbit:review --as system --reviewer blind-pair foo`), and since rc18 an outstanding review pass makes the walk lead instead. The rule the scenario states (the lead is the graph's command, never a literal) is still right; only its example is a superseded schema's. Restate the example under v5, or drop the version-specific example and keep the rule. rc18 carried this block and left the example as it found it.
